prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a serene hospital ward bathed in soft, diffused light. In the center, a patient lies in a white bed, covered by a pale blue blanket, holding the hand of a visiting nurse dressed in crisp white scrubs. To the left, a doctor in a long white coat examines a chart clipped to the foot of the bed, while an elderly woman in a floral dress sits on a wooden chair nearby, looking concerned. A small table beside the bed holds a glass vase with yellow flowers, a plastic water pitcher, and a ringing telephone. On the right, a young boy in a red sweater feeds applesauce to a smaller child sitting on a wheelchair. A tall IV stand with a clear bag hangs next to the main bed. In the background, large windows reveal a blurry green park outside, letting in natural daylight that reflects off the polished floor. A medical monitor on a rolling cart displays steady lines in the foreground. The interactions include holding hands, examining charts, sitting, feeding, and looking, creating a narrative of care and concern. The watercolor technique blends soft edges and pastel hues, emphasizing the calm atmosphere of the medical environment without sharp contrasts or harsh lines.
